name: Bisonatee
body:
BISONATEE
CR 9

XP 6,400
LG Large magical beast (aquatic)
Init -1; Senses blindsight 30, low-light vision

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 8, flat-footed 22 (-1 Dex, +14 natural, -1 size)
hp 150 (12d10+84)
Fort +16, Ref +9, Will +13

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 40 ft.
Melee gore +14 (2d8+2), 2 slams +12 (1d6+2)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks draining aura, enlightened counter

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 8, Con 22, Int 13, Wis 24, Cha 16
Base Atk +12; CMB +15; CMD 23
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Natural Armor, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Toughness
Skills Perception +12, Stealth +12 (+16 when immobile); Racial Modifiers +4 to Stealth when immobile
Languages Aquan, Bisonatee, Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Draining Aura (Su)

Creatures fighting a bisonatee find themselves plagued with laziness and distraction. Each hostile creature within 60 ft of the bisonatee takes one point of temporary ability damage to both strength and Dexterity each round. Points are restored at a rate of 1/ hour.

Enlightened Counter (Su)

The bisonatee counters the first hostile spell cast with it as the target, as per dispel magic. A dispel check must be made by the bisonatee.

ECOLOGY

Environment aquatic
Organization solitary
Treasure none

Cousin to the sea cow, the bisonatee also left the land and returned to the water for food and protection. This creature has the head, horns, and neck of a bison, with the large flippers and tail of a manatee.

A bisonatee will affect you long before you see, hear, or sense it. This large, usually peaceful creature floats in the water, feeding off the energy of both land and aquatic prey of varying sizes. It has no interest in swimming quickly or expending additional energy, and prefers to loll about and munch seaweed and other water plants. It has a natural resistance to magic, and given its ability to drain the energy of hostile creatures, it rarely needs to resort to physical measures to defend itself. When provoked however, the bisonatee is quite capable of defending itself with its horns and its large tail, goring or thrashing with such power as to overturn a boat, drown a creature, or knock its attacker unconscious. Bisonatees are thought to be operating on a different plane than typical animals, and to have access to cosmic insights that grant them their sense of inner peace and indifference to violence.
